notes.title: Update on October 29th
notes.content:
Fix the following issues:

 Some NPC dialogues did not trigger properly
 Resolution not saved properly

notes.title: BUG FIXES
notes.content:
Sorry! This patch should have been released on the first day;
Due to the invalid mobile phone number of the account, the game cannot be updated. After communicating with the Steam customer service, even if the mobile phone number is changed, the game cannot be updated within 72 hours, so the update has to be delayed until today.
But now it can finally be updated normally. Welcome to give me suggestions. If there are any problems, we will definitely fix them! (As long as it is within our ability)
The following BUGs have been fixed:

 Airship movement problem
 Level reset problem at level 100
 Sound effect cannot be completely turned off
 Sound effect save problem in settings
 There are also some other BUG fixes
